crew.overview: With only three weeks left in his three-year contract, Sam Bell is getting anxious to finally return to Earth. He is the only occupant of a Moon-based manufacturing facility along with his computer and assistant, GERTY. When he has an accident however, he awakens to find that he is not alone.
crew.title: Moon

crew.original_title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
crew.overview: A card shark and his unwillingly-enlisted friends need to make a lot of cash quick after losing a sketchy poker match. To do this they decide to pull a heist on a small-time gang who happen to be operating out of the flat next door.
crew.title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels

details.biography: Marc Lawes is a Sound Designer and 3x Bafta Nominee (The Hour), Emmy Nominee (The Bible) and RTS Winner (Bodyguard). He has done Sound Design and Editing for Molinare LTD and his own company Marc Lawes Sound LTD. He has worked extensively in television and film throughout his career.
details.name: Marc Lawes
